from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFixedAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """Fixed assets data extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company issuing the report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock security code if present in the document")
    fixed_assets_balance: float | None = Field(description="The ending balance amount for fixed assets")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the amount, e.g., Yuan")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period, e.g., Q1 2024")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    fixed_asset_records: list[CompanyFixedAssetRecord]
